description: Create a new Classification associated with the specified company.

id.description: Unique identifier for this work classification.

name.description: Display name of the work classification.

company_id.description: ID of the company this classification belongs to.

deletable.description: Whether this classification can be deleted. False when timecard entries reference it.

company_visible.description: Whether this classification is visible at the company level.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this classification was last updated.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this classification was created.

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created this classification.

project_ids.description: IDs of active projects associated with this classification.
